The '''Enarc system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] containing the planet [[Enarc/Legends|Enarc]]. It was one of the endpoints of a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] named after it, the [[Enarc Run/Legends|Enarc Run]]. The system was the original location of a [[Medcenter/Legends|medcenter]] that was eventually moved to the [[Kaliida Nebula/Legends|Kaliida Nebula]] and renamed [[Kaliida Shoals Medical Center/Legends|Kaliida Shoals Medical Center]].

In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], the system played a role in the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Blockade of Naboo]]. A [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] vessel at the edges of the [[Naboo system/Legends|Naboo system]] warned inbound vessels against trading with the system. The vessel offered to purchase cargo bound for the Naboo system and replace it with outbound cargo, directing all interested parties to the Trade Federation distribution center located in the Enarc system.<ref name="Secrets of Naboo">''[[Secrets of Naboo]]''</ref>
